title: Ironing out oxygen instability
abstract: Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02153-z Oxygen redox in layered-oxide cathodes could facilitate the development of high-energy sodium-ion batteries, but poor reversibility has limited its practical application. Now, an iron-mediated redox strategy offers a pathway to substantially improving oxygen-redox reversibility.

title: An extra beat every minute
abstract: Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02156-w Small deviations in the power system frequency are routinely attributed to stochastic fluctuations in load and generation. New research reveals a disturbance recurring precisely every minute in grids worldwide, caused by clock-synchronized self-tests in battery-based uninterruptible power supplies that inadvertently act in unison.
